decision: Approve the render-mode convention proposed by Chip v0.2 for the mode prop: one pill that renders as a pressable toggle, a static label or a native link, selected by an explicit role prop rather than a boolean flag or implicit href inference.

evidence.channel: Owner decision forwarded in odd/tasks/web-catalog.md L13, 2026-11-02 (recorded in docs/components/web-catalog/v0.1/layer-b-plan-approvals.md)
evidence.interpretation: Explicit convention approval reported by the parent; this is not a signed or independent receipt, and it does not rewrite the earlier convention approvals.

convention.name: mode
convention.meaning: The semantic role and rendered element of a component whose behavior differs per role, when the role is not a visual treatment.
convention.whenToUse: A component keeps one appearance and content contract but must render as a non-interactive element, a pressable control or a link.
convention.avoid: Visual presentation (use variant), data-entry kind (use kind), selection cardinality (use type) or a boolean flag per role.
